selection_rationale: M377-03 survives as a proved but strictly partial large-prime-tail lemma. M377-07 is the only unrefuted closure-oriented mechanism: it must be a cutoff-aware, genuinely many-base Fourier or large-sieve inequality, because exact CRT replay proves full-period independence but refutes every-prefix product domination, while the EGRS theorem proves that every two fixed odd primes are simultaneously carry-free infinitely often. Ten other mechanisms are killed by exact residue witnesses, persistent fixed-prime depth, incompatible contraction blocks, overlapping CRT cylinders, or a complete unpaid-loss ledger. Neither survivor currently proves the public conjecture.
